people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
translations.bsb: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
translations.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
translations.asv: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
